1239|c86281a7.name: First Mate Fitzsimmons
1239|c86281a7.text: If you're willing to endure tales that will shiver your timbers and sog your skivvies, then get yourself a drink and sit for a spell...

1464|4a0923b3.name: Innkeeper Helbrek
1464|4a0923b3.text: Are you interested in exploring one of these dungeons?

1464|b63e4e81.name: Innkeeper Helbrek
1464|b63e4e81.text: Fill yer tankard and pull up a chair. We've stories to tell and kegs to empty.

1464|f331e69a.name: Innkeeper Helbrek
1464|f331e69a.text: The entrance to Whelgar's Excavation Site can be found in the southern valley of the Wetlands. A cave along the western mountain ridge marks the passage.

2104|fe329646.name: Captain Stoutfist
2104|fe329646.text: Menethil Harbor enjoys a bit of peace these days, thanks to the mountaineers.  But we must be ever watchful of new threats from our enemies.

279-accept.name: Karl Boran
279-accept.text:
Murlocs are crawling out from the deep waters and building their villages on the coastline.  They are harassing our fishers and merchants and must be stopped.

One of these Murlocs, Gobbler, skulks with other Bluegill Murlocs and harries merchants along the road, always then retreating to the safety of the nearby Murloc hovels.  Our merchants are in jeopardy, and we will pay to secure them.

Gobbler prowls the river inlet north of here.  Find him, slay his kin, and bring me his head.
279-accept.title: Claws from the Deep

288-accept.name: First Mate Fitzsimmons
288-accept.text:
I was once First Mate on the Wave Mistress, ship-of-the-line in the Kul Tiras Third Fleet. The Doomed Fleet. Doomed, for on its last voyage the fleet was attacked by Red Dragons. Dragons controlled by Orcs!

We didn't stand a chance against that dragonfire...and our fleet was burned and sunk off this here coast. I'm the sole survivor of those poor vessels...

...Oh, my head hammers and pounds! I'll need a fresh drink if I'm to get a handle on this hangover and continue my tale.
288-accept.title: The Third Fleet

288-complete.name: First Mate Fitzsimmons
288-complete.text: Ah! That hits the spot, and loosens the tongue. Thanks, mate!
288-complete.title: The Third Fleet

288-progress.name: First Mate Fitzsimmons
288-progress.text: Oh, I'm so very thirsty! Won't you buy a drink for this poor, pathetic fool?
288-progress.title: The Third Fleet

289-accept.name: First Mate Fitzsimmons
289-accept.text:
<Bolstered, Fitzsimmons continues his tale...>

I am the sole survivor of the ill-fated Third Fleet of Kul Tiras, wrecked off the coast to the north. But although I'm the only member of the fleet still breathing, I'm not the only one still walking about! For on one of our ships was hidden a great, and terrible treasure, and the eerie power of it keeps the souls of my brothers trapped within the ships' rotting hulls.

But if you can free some of my brothers, then perhaps you can break their curse.
289-accept.title: The Cursed Crew

463-accept.name: First Mate Fitzsimmons
463-accept.text:
You've heard of the Greenwarden? You're not looking for him, are you? Well I say you're crazy if you are, but who am I to keep a fool from his death?

If you are seeking that beast, then I hear he is in the marsh, east of the road where it forks to Dun Modr. He's lurking there among the crocs...and worse!

And leave your money here. You won't need it where you're going...and you don't want to chip ol' Greenie's tooth on your gold when he bites you in half, do you?
463-accept.title: The Greenwarden

464-accept.name: Captain Stoutfist
464-accept.text:
The Dragonmaw orc clan was all but destroyed by the end of the Second War, after they lost control of their red dragon pets. The dragons were not very happy with their old masters, and fiercely hunted the Dragonmaws. What few remained fled from Grim Batol and into the Mountains east of Whelgar's Excavation.

Now they've gained strength, and have an encampment northeast of Menethil.

We want you to attack that encampment. Gather and bring me their war banners as proof.
464-accept.title: War Banners

470-accept.name: Sida
470-accept.text:
On my weekly visit to Ironbeard's Tomb I was attacked by dreadful, dripping oozes! Naturally, I panicked.

I threw my bag at one, but it didn't do anything! The ooze just sucked it right up... Luckily, it did give me enough time to get away.

The bad news is that I really need to get the contents of my bag!

I don't know which ooze I threw my bag at; they all looked the same! Ironbeard's Tomb is northeast of here, near Dun Modr. Thank you so much!
470-accept.title: Digging Through the Ooze

472-accept.name: Harlo Barnaby
472-accept.text:
Dun Modr has fallen to the Dark Iron Dwarves!

My wounds are grave, $c.  Most of the regiment was killed!  The Dark Iron thugs attacked us before we could regroup from the Thandol Span ambush.

Our leader, Longbraid, sounded the retreat horn.  As we left the town I was hit by a stray axe in the back.  All went black.

I awoke here in Menethil but I fear for my fellow soldiers.  Hope still burns within me.  Perhaps Longbraid is still alive!  See if you can find him near Dun Modr, $r!
472-accept.title: Fall of Dun Modr

484-accept.name: James Halloran
484-accept.text:
I'm James Halloran, the tanner. My cured crocolisk skins are sought after all over, shipments leaving by boat to ports around the world.

Met Einar? He's one of the hunters that brings crocolisk skins in for me.

I'm a bit short on the softer skins that come off crocolisk young.

Being that I'm running low, I'll pay you top coin for a stack of the skins. You can find the young crocs in the waters right outside of town.
484-accept.title: Young Crocolisk Skins

95647-accept.name: Caitlin Grassman
95647-accept.text:
My husband, Ardin, has a rare gift for sensing nature. He'll scale any peak to gather the herbs and flowers I need for my alchemy, keeping our shelves and pantry stocked.

But I fear he's wandered into trouble. An excavation crew passed through seeking supplies. They spoke, among other things, of towering grasses unlike anything they'd ever seen. Those were what he told me he had to go see for himself. He's been gone too long!

If you learn anything of him, I'd be grateful.
95647-accept.title: Lost in the Thicket Things

98197-accept.name: Valstag Ironjaw
98197-accept.text:
This harbor was first built by the Old Horde as a staging ground for their naval invasion of Hillsbrad. Completely circumvented Lordaeron's defenses!

So many lives lost...

What's worse is that fleet was built with the very resources they stole from Khaz Modan!

Plenty of it remains in the harbor after Admiral Proudmoore routed the brutes and built this place for the Alliance. We'll need it to bolster the town's defenses with the Dragonmaw on the move.
98197-accept.title: Spoils of War

98208-accept.name: Sylessa Duskwhisper
98208-accept.text:
I came to Menethil Harbor from Auberdine, from the great tree Teldrassil, to recover a bloom of great import to my people.

My people's ship the Flying Osprey crashed here many moons ago, joined with the Kul Tiran Third Fleet. Among its cargo was the flower known as Nord'el--Bloom of the Heavens in your tongue--bloomed under a full moon at the peak of Mount Hyjal, our former home.

Please help me retrieve it! The wreckage is just south of the city, but it is inhabited by fierce murloc raiders!
98208-accept.title: Bloom of the Heavens

98221-accept.name: Captain Stoutfist
98221-accept.text:
In the Second War the Dragonmaw built a fleet where we now stand, intending to take Hillsbrad. They nearly succeeded!

They were routed by the red dragons, left to mere stragglers deep in the mountains. However, there has been a surge in activity in their encampment northeast of Menethil.

Dun Algaz is proof that they intend to march to war once again and retake this land. Find their attack plans, take note of any critical information, and destroy them. We need to know where they will strike next!
98221-accept.title: From the Ashes

98282-accept.name: Caitlin Grassman
98282-accept.text:
Certain alchemical recipes require ingredients sourced from, well, very dangerous places. And those are often just the base herbs! The other ingredients are even worse!

I need to make more antivenom before I can leave again. I swear everything in this marsh is venomous. It's like it runs through the land itself!

Can you help me? I'll need a venom gland from the spiders in Thelgen Rock to the far southeast. But it has to be unruptured, or too much venom will spill out before you can get here. Sorry!
98282-accept.title: Alchemical Hazards
